meta.name: BET
meta.description:
Kick back and enjoy the best of Black Hollywood in movies and TV! Featuring hundreds of hours of beloved films and familiar TV series, this channel is sure to have everything you’ve been looking for in one place, 24 hours a day.

Shows: One On One, The Game, Half & Half, Ms. Pat Settles It, The Parkers
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus
